environment: Integrated optimized iOS Simulator model tests using the actual Mail session, SQLite stores, live source and draft driver with deterministic fake providers.

foreground.method: Cold session used by a shell read and one push. The reference activates the live source when constructing the session. Each source uses an independent disk store. Advance the same injected clock through four 30-second intervals, then enter and leave a Mail window. The separate session test keeps polling active with two visible windows until the last leaves.

outage.method: The failing account faces a push every five simulated seconds for 15 minutes while the other account remains healthy. A local starred edit is durable during the outage. After the retry deadline, the feed recovers. Reopening the intent store and live source confirms the star.

outbox.method: Former fixed 30-second scheduler and current deadline scheduler query the same SQLite store across a simulated hour. Count the initial scan and every wake through the inclusive endpoint. Repeat with a saved draft held beyond the window. A separate test covers the due send, lost provider response and same-operation retry after reopening the store.
